name: Tiller & Persinger 2002: 'Thomas' FM pattern, 3-ms points, right (5 min)
origin: Tiller & Persinger 2002 (Laurentian University); 'Thomas' pattern after Alex W. Thomas (US 6,234,953)
summary: The 849-point 'Thomas' frequency-modulated table of US 6,234,953 at 3 ms per point (a 2.55-s decelerating burst, repeated), mainly over the right parietotemporal region for 5 min. Tiller & Persinger 2002 (12 people) reported more left-sided presence reports in this block (mean 0.8 presses) than in the other blocks (0.2), and that the time-reversed pattern was less effective.
notes: 12 subjects got eight 5-min blocks in one fixed order: a 'multiple complexly sequenced' pattern at 1 and 3 ms, a 10-Hz sine at 1 ms, the Thomas pattern at 1 and then 3 ms, the reversed Thomas pattern at 3 ms, and the LTP pattern at 1 and 3 ms. This program is block 5, always straight after the same pattern at 1 ms. The helmet had four pairs of solenoids, each pair on for 5 s, 'primarily over the right parietotemporal region' (Tiller 2002 p.1-2 [26-27]). This program plays the 849 values of Table 1 of US 6,234,953 at 3 ms per point with a 3-ms pause between repeats, and the left side at a fifth of the right. The pause and the fifth are from the helmet paper (Persinger 2000 p.3 [661]); this paper gives neither. At this speed each 84-ms pulse has two positive peaks, 24 per second at the start, and the last pulses come 201 ms apart: the lab's '25 to 6 Hz'. One left-right pair is on at a time (5 s each), and the right side is reversed so that the pair's field points through the head. The four sites per side stand for the lab helmet's four solenoids per side on a 7.5 by 5 cm ellipse; the site names are this project's reading. Field: 'approximately 1 microTesla (10 milligauss)' averaged over the scalp (p.2 [27]). This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. At 1 uT this helmet's field model gives a peak of about 24 uT at the scalp, over ten times the paper's average. Result: left-sided presses averaged 0.8 in this block against 0.2 in the other cells (p.2 [27]). One lab, no independent test. persinger-tiller-2002-thomas-reversed is block 6. Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). Not for people with epilepsy or a seizure history, implanted devices or pregnancy; stop at once on fear, headache or distress.
setting: Blindfolded or with opaque goggles in a quiet, dark room; press a button, speak, or tell a helper the moment anything is felt and on which side (left, right, front or back).
schedule: One 5-min block. In the original it was the fifth of eight 5-min blocks, given to every subject in the same order. At most once a week.
source: Tiller & Persinger 2002, Percept Mot Skills 94:26 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/11883572/ ; Thomas, Prato, Kavaliers & Persinger, US 6,234,953 B1, Table 1 https://patents.google.com/patent/US6234953B1/en ; Buckner et al. 2015, PLoS ONE 10(4):e0124136 (849 points at 3 ms, 2.55-s cycle) https://europepmc.org/article/MED/25875081 ; Murugan 2013, thesis, Laurentian University, pp. 44-45 (248-point burst-x, 849-point Thomas pulse, 3-ms points) https://laurentian.scholaris.ca/items/39c9c1ad-70ba-458d-a819-d24c20da217a ; Persinger & Belanger-Chellew 1999, Percept Mot Skills 89:486 (3-ms pixel and interstimulus optimum in rats) https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/10597585/ ; Dixon & Persinger 2001, Int J Neurosci 108:87 (837 values at 1 ms, once every 4 s) https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/11328704/ ; Granqvist et al. 2005, Neurosci Lett 379:1 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15849873/ ; Persinger & Koren 2005, A response to Granqvist et al., Neurosci Lett 380:346 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15862915/ ; Gendle & McGrath 2012, Percept Mot Skills 114:217 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22582690/
